text:
sam: heads-up found a broken anchor from the troubleshooting section in the runbook. link text ‘KV cache: tuning-guidelines’ goes to /docs/runtime/kv-cache/tuning-guidelines and returns 404 in staging.

tara: ugh, thanks. can you paste the failing URL so i can reproduce?

sam: sure: `https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache/tuning-guidelines`
```bash
curl -sI https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache/tuning-guidelines | head -n 1
# HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```

erin: that path looks like it was flattened in the last docs reorg. iirc we moved the tuning page under /runtime/kv-cache-tuning.md. quick win is to add a redirect rule, longer term map anchors.

zack: I can do the redirect PR and add a tiny CI check for link health. would like to also add a docs_linkcheck CI job step so future renames get caught earlier.

tara: yes please. redirect first then update the runbook to point to the canonical page + anchor. add CODEOWNERS to the runbook header if missing so we don't lose ownership.

kb-bot: docs-scan alert: anchor not found (severity: medium)  created ticket DOCS-940.

zack: plan: 1) redirect entry in static-routing.yaml (PR), 2) update runbook anchor to canonical path (follow-up PR), 3) add lightweight linkcheck in .github/workflows/docs.yml. i'll tag @erin and @tara for review. ETA EOD PST.

erin: sounds good. for the CI job keep it cheap run linkchecker only on PRs that touch docs/, and fail only on new breaks (existing ones log as warnings).

sam: thanks all. ping me on the redirect PR and ill validate in staging once deployed. :+1:

tara: also leaving a note in the runbook frontmatter `owners: @platform-docs` so it's discoverable.

zack: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7423 (redirect). adding DOCS-940 link in description.

sam: saw it, approving now. will smoke test in staging after merge.

erin: after merge let's add a small test that curls the redirect URL and asserts 200. keeps the regression window tiny.

zack: agreed. will include the smoke curl test in the follow-up PR.

sam: nice! closing my local checklist. thanks team. :rocket:
